commands: apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl git openssl
until k3s kubectl get nodes; do sleep 5; done
k3s kubectl create namespace argocd --dry-run=client -o yaml | k3s kubectl apply -f -
k3s kubectl -n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-server --timeout=10m
k3s kubectl create namespace monitoring --dry-run=client -o yaml | k3s kubectl apply -f -

k3s kubectl -n monitoring create secret generic monitoring-grafana --from-literal=admin-user=admin --from-literal=admin-password="$(openssl rand -base64 24)" --dry-run=client -o yaml | k3s kubectl apply -f -
k3s kubectl -n monitoring create secret generic alertmanager-telegram --from-literal=bot-token=disabled --dry-run=client -o yaml | k3s kubectl apply -f -
echo 'K3s, Argo CD and the monitoring stack have been started.'
